---
title: "Execution Profiles and Local/Manual-HPC Handoff"
---

SCGSim plans one common run-and-handoff contract. It does not define separate
runners for different machines.

## Fixed machine profiles

| Profile | Intended use | Required receipt scope |
|---|---|---|
| LTlab direct-local compiled binary | Smoke, debug, mesh/config validation, and small solves | Executable identity, inputs, environment, exit state, artifacts |
| LTlab single-node Slurm | `sbatch`, MPI/OpenMP, scheduler lifecycle, resource receipt, and result resolution | Scheduler/job identity, resources, launch shape, artifacts, resolution state |
| F1 multi-node/high-memory Slurm | Production-scale runs | Scheduler/job identity, nodes/resources, launch shape, artifacts, resolution state |

Machine differences live in profile data and receipts. They do not fork the
run model.

## Handoff lifecycle

```text
prepare inputs -> validate -> package handoff -> execute or transfer manually
-> collect immutable results -> resolve -> report
```

External gdsfactory/cloud execution is unsupported and must never be used as a
fallback. No execution or handoff API is implemented in Phase 1.
